tools.description: Install the artifacts a plan checked, compare-and-set on the plan's baseVersion: refused with nothing written if the workspace moved, the checker refuses, or stored records break the new laws. The answer is the installed version and its receipt. The pack's actions are callable at once with norn_call_action, before their own tools appear.

approvals.description: The pack's approvals: admitted against these artifacts' actions and installed with them in one transaction, so a new action is never live without its gate. A plan returns each one's restatement and restatementSha256; an apply carries each one's signoff of it and the plan's fromRevision as expectedVersion. Any refusal installs nothing.

The input is the action's input object; fields the server fills (the actor, the clock) are not yours to send. The workspace's laws and policy decide it: the answer is a receipt or a refusal with its reason.

tools.description: Admit and answer a typed question (QuestionIR) over the workspace's declared metrics, once, without saving it. The checker refuses a question that names undeclared metrics or mixes incompatible units, with the reason. Take the metric name and its object type from norn_question_catalog (a metric's type_params.metric_aggregation_params.semantic_model is the objectSet). Every field below is required; keep the window to the period asked about (a year at most), and add groupBy only when a breakdown is asked for: {"irVersion": "0.1", "name": "stock_now", "objectSet": "canon.Holding", "aggregate": [{"metric": "<metric name>"}], "groupBy": [], "filter": [], "window": {"start": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "end": "2026-12-01T00:00:00Z"}, "calendar": "iso_utc", "freshness": {"kind": "live", "maxAgeMs": 5000}}. Then trace a bucket with norn_trace_evaluated.
